svg.text: ORDER KEEPS A RANGE IN ONE PIECE
sorted array: every key from 40 to 70
sorted array: the largest key ≤ 60, and the nearest to 60
first key greater than 60: index 9; the floor is the key before it, 53, in 4 comparisons
the nearest key is 53 or 61: here 61
hash table, a model with 16 buckets: bucket = key mod 16
the range's five keys land in buckets 4, 5, 10, 13, 15: a range query must look at all 16 keys
for integer keys only, it can instead probe each of the 31 values 40, 41, …, 70
